entries.label: s2_sub_042_poke_01
entries.text: Tera-lu-mi!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_01a
entries.text: Well now.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_01b
entries.text: Well now.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_02a
entries.text: This is a curious development... Have I somehow\nbroken through the boundaries of space-time?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_02b
entries.text: This is a curious development... Have I somehow\nbroken through the boundaries of space-time?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_03a
entries.text: And who are you?[VAR 0x0114(000D)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_03b
entries.text: And who are you?[VAR 0x0114(0010)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_01
entries.text: P-Professor?!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_02
entries.text: Are you the AI—?!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_04a
entries.text: Have we met? If so, I’m sorry, but I don’t seem to\nrecall it...[VAR 0x0114(000D)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_04b
entries.text: Have we met? If so, I’m sorry, but I don’t seem to\nrecall it...[VAR 0x0114(0010)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_05a
entries.text:
What’s that you say? You thought I was some
robot imbued with an AI personality?\c
Hmm. Now that’s an idea. If I could create such
a thing, it would be quite helpful...[VAR 0x0114(000D)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_05b
entries.text:
What’s that you say? You thought I was some
robot imbued with an AI personality?\c
Hmm. Now that’s an idea. If I could create such
a thing, it would be quite helpful...[VAR 0x0114(0010)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_06a
entries.text: I am Professor Sada.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_06b
entries.text: I am Professor Turo.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_07a
entries.text: I research Pokémon in Area Zero. And yet—[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_07b
entries.text: I research Pokémon in Area Zero. And yet—[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_legend_01
entries.text: Agia gias!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_09a
entries.text: Th-this Pokémon—! Is this the Winged King?![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_09b
entries.text: Th-this Pokémon—! Is this the Iron Serpent?![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_03a
entries.text: This is Koraidon!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_03b
entries.text: This is Miraidon!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_04a
entries.text: We call it Koraidon

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_04b
entries.text: We call it Miraidon

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_10a
entries.text: Is that right? So its name is Koraidon...\c\nHm. That’s a good name.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_10b
entries.text: Is that right? So its name is Miraidon...\c\nHm. That’s a good name.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_legend_02
entries.text: Agian?

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_11a
entries.text: From the clues you’ve already let slip, I suppose\nI would have to conclude...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_11b
entries.text: From the clues you’ve already let slip, I suppose\nI would have to conclude...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_12a
entries.text: From your perspective, I must have come from\nthe past...?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_12b
entries.text: From my perspective, this must be the future...?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_13a
entries.text: Though of course the complexities of space-time\nare beyond count...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_13b
entries.text: Though of course the complexities of space-time\nare beyond count...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_14a
entries.text: It’s possible that our encounter might not even\nbe occurring in a timeline connected to my own.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_14b
entries.text: It’s possible that our encounter might not even\nbe occurring in a timeline connected to my own.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_15
entries.text: [EMPTY 136]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_16a
entries.text: Perhaps this meeting is nothing more than a\nfleeting miracle.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_16b
entries.text: Perhaps this meeting is nothing more than a\nfleeting miracle.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_17a
entries.text: Why don’t we exchange as much useful data as\nwe can, in what little time that fate has gifted us?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_17b
entries.text: Why don’t we exchange as much useful data as\nwe can, in what little time that fate has gifted us?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_stopper_01a
entries.text: This is your chance to talk to Professor Sada!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_stopper_01b
entries.text: This is your chance to talk to Professor Turo!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_18a
entries.text: Is there anything that you would like to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_18b
entries.text: Is there anything that you would like to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_05
entries.text: Why are you here?

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_06
entries.text: What are you studying now?

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_07
entries.text: What about your family...?

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_19a
entries.text: I don’t precisely know the cause. I was analyzing\nsome recent data in my secret lab one moment,\r\nand the next I was standing here before you.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_19b
entries.text: I don’t precisely know the cause. I was analyzing\nsome recent data in my secret lab one moment,\r\nand the next I was standing here before you.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_20a
entries.text: Perhaps this is the influence of the crystal\nPokémon that lies dormant in that place...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_20b
entries.text: Perhaps this is the influence of the crystal\nPokémon that lies dormant in that place...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_21a
entries.text: Or perhaps the cause lies with you and I...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_21b
entries.text: Or perhaps the cause lies with you and I...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_22a
entries.text: I am researching methods to catch Pokémon that\nlive in different timelines, so I might transport\r\nthem to the present day in my own timeline.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_22b
entries.text: I am researching methods to catch Pokémon that\nlive in different timelines, so I might transport\r\nthem to the present day in my own timeline.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_23a
entries.text: It sounds fantastical, no doubt, but I am drafting\nplans now for a machine that may achieve it.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_23b
entries.text: It sounds fantastical, no doubt, but I am drafting\nplans now for a machine that may achieve it.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_24a
entries.text: You see, this book captured my imagination when\nI read it as a child and has never let go.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_24b
entries.text: You see, this book captured my imagination when\nI read it as a child and has never let go.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_25a
entries.text: But progress has been slow and beset by failures.\nI haven’t left my lab in quite some time now...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_25b
entries.text: But progress has been slow and beset by failures.\nI haven’t left my lab in quite some time now...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_26a
entries.text: I desperately hope that I might glean some new\ninsight from this conversation, so I can finally\r\nmake some progress and return home...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_26b
entries.text: I desperately hope that I might glean some new\ninsight from this conversation, so I can finally\r\nmake some progress and return home...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_27a
entries.text: Oh, you even wish to know about my private life?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_27b
entries.text: Oh, you even wish to know about my private life?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_28a
entries.text: I do...have family. A son.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_28b
entries.text: I do...have family. A son.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_29a
entries.text:
He is probably at home right now... Well, no,
I suppose “right now” could be inaccurate.\c
Whenever and wherever he is, I imagine he must
be...quite lonely.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_29b
entries.text:
He is probably at home right now... Well, no,
I suppose “right now” could be inaccurate.\c
Whenever and wherever he is, I imagine he must
be...quite lonely.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_30a
entries.text: Is there anything else you wish to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_30b
entries.text: Is there anything else you wish to ask me?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_31a
entries.text: Now, let us trade places in this exchange. I’d say\nthe time has come for my own questions.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_31b
entries.text: Now, let us trade places in this exchange. I’d say\nthe time has come for my own questions.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_32a
entries.text: What is this place? It doesn’t appear to be\nanywhere in Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_32b
entries.text: What is this place? It doesn’t appear to be\nanywhere in Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_08
entries.text: This is the land of Kitakami

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_09
entries.text: This here is the Crystal Pool

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_33a
entries.text: So we’re at Kitakami’s Crystal Pool, eh? I\nremember reading about it in certain texts.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_33b
entries.text: So we’re at Kitakami’s Crystal Pool, eh? I\nremember reading about it in certain texts.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_34a
entries.text: It’s said to be a place where water wells up from\nthe ground, imbued with Terastal energy.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_34b
entries.text: It’s said to be a place where water wells up from\nthe ground, imbued with Terastal energy.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_35a
entries.text: It would seem that I have been shifted quite far\nin both space and time.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_35b
entries.text: It would seem that I have been shifted quite far\nin both space and time.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_36a
entries.text: My next question, then...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_36b
entries.text: My next question, then...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_37a
entries.text: That Pokémon you have, the Winged King—\nAh, I mean...Koraidon. Tell me more about it.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_37b
entries.text: That Pokémon you have, the Iron Serpent—\nAh, I mean...Miraidon. Tell me more about it.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_10
entries.text: I found it collapsed on a beach

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_11
entries.text: It’s a precious partner to me

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_12
entries.text: You can ride it all over the place!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_38a
entries.text:
Did you really? Then I wonder whence it came
and how it happened to arrive at that beach.\c
Though it appears you don’t know much about
the creature’s exact origins yourself.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_38b
entries.text:
Did you really? Then I wonder whence it came
and how it happened to arrive at that beach.\c
Though it appears you don’t know much about
the creature’s exact origins yourself.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_39a
entries.text: Yes, well, your personal attachment to the\ncreature has no meaningful relevance to the—\c\nAh... Forgive me. Perhaps that was rude.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_39b
entries.text: Yes, well, your personal attachment to the\ncreature has no meaningful relevance to the—\c\nAh... Forgive me. Perhaps that was rude.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_40a
entries.text:
My initial thought was that it bears a striking
resemblance to Cyclizar. Wouldn’t you agree?\c
Perhaps some ancient form of Cyclizar... If so, it
does lend a hint of credence to my hypotheses.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_40b
entries.text:
My initial thought was that it bears a striking
resemblance to Cyclizar. Wouldn’t you agree?\c
Perhaps some future form of Cyclizar... If so, it
does lend a hint of credence to my hypotheses.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_legend_03
entries.text: Agia!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_41a
entries.text: Hm? That book you have there... I don’t\nrecognize its cover. What is it?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_41b
entries.text: Hm? That book you have there... I don’t\nrecognize its cover. What is it?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_42a
entries.text: “The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero”...? W-would\nyou let me see it for just a moment?![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_42b
entries.text: “The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero”...? W-would\nyou let me see it for just a moment?![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_43a
entries.text: Descriptions of the Area Zero Underdepths!\nAnd—and a record of Terapagos’s awakening?![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_43b
entries.text: Descriptions of the Area Zero Underdepths!\nAnd—and a record of Terapagos’s awakening?![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_44a
entries.text: Who is this Briar, to have written such a work?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_44b
entries.text: Who is this Briar, to have written such a work?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_13
entries.text: She’s a teacher of mine

entries.label: s2_sub_042_select_14
entries.text: She’s a descendant of Heath

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_45a
entries.text:
A schoolteacher? Plumbing the depths of Area
Zero?\c
Access is supposed to be limited to myself and
certain members of the Pokémon League...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_45b
entries.text:
A schoolteacher? Plumbing the depths of Area
Zero?\c
Access is supposed to be limited to myself and
certain members of the Pokémon League...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_46a
entries.text: Now isn’t that something. A descendant of the\nauthor of the original Scarlet Book...\c\nExploration runs in the family, I see.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_46b
entries.text: Now isn’t that something. A descendant of the\nauthor of the original Violet Book...\c\nExploration runs in the family, I see.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_47a
entries.text: At any rate, that is a book that would ignite the\nimagination of any true scientist![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_47b
entries.text: At any rate, that is a book that would ignite the\nimagination of any true scientist![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_48a
entries.text: I’m sorry, but I simply must have the time to read\nthis book more thoroughly![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_48b
entries.text: I’m sorry, but I simply must have the time to read\nthis book more thoroughly![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_49a
entries.text: Oh! The mist is closing in once again... I assume\nthat means our time is near its end.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_49b
entries.text: Oh! The mist is closing in once again... I assume\nthat means our time is near its end.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_legend_04
entries.text: Gias! Gia!

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_50a
entries.text:
I wish I could spend longer getting to know the
Winged King...but I must hurry.\c
That book... I imagine it must be quite valuable.\c
It wouldn’t feel right for me to claim it without
offering you any recompense.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_50b
entries.text:
I wish I could spend longer getting to know the
Iron Serpent...but I must hurry.\c
That book... I imagine it must be quite valuable.\c
It wouldn’t feel right for me to claim it without
offering you any recompense.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_51a
entries.text:
An exchange, then. Though I hate to part with
something so precious to me...\c
Would you consider trading me that book for
my copy of the Scarlet Book?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_51b
entries.text:
An exchange, then. Though I hate to part with
something so precious to me...\c
Would you consider trading me that book for
my copy of the Violet Book?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_52a
entries.text: Please. You must reconsider.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_52b
entries.text: Please. You must reconsider.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_53a
entries.text: I appreciate this more than you can imagine.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_53b
entries.text: I appreciate this more than you can imagine.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_54a
entries.text: Perhaps I should take this chance to go home\nand enjoy a bit of downtime with a good book...[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_54b
entries.text: Perhaps I should take this chance to go home\nand enjoy a bit of downtime with a good book...[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_55a
entries.text:
This is where we part, fellow adventurer and
Winged King.\c
How lucky we were to meet across space
and time.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_55b
entries.text:
This is where we part, fellow adventurer and
Iron Serpent.\c
How lucky we were to meet across space
and time.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_56a
entries.text: I bid you adieu![VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_hakase_56b
entries.text: I bid you adieu![VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_friend_npca
entries.text:
Oh, that the Scarlet Book? Did you borrow the
copy in the entrance hall?\c
’Course you did! That book holds a lot of
memories for us, little buddy.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: s2_sub_042_friend_npcb
entries.text:
Oh, that the Violet Book? Did you borrow the
copy in the entrance hall?\c
’Course you did! That book holds a lot of
memories for us, little buddy.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
